title: Zoll magnetic structures and ruled surfaces
summary: A Zoll magnetic system on an oriented closed surface $M$ is a Riemannian metric $g$ together with a function $λ\colon M\to \mathbb{R}$, such that every unit speed solution of the ODE $\ddot γ(t)=λ(γ(t))γ(t)^\perp$ is periodic and the minimal period depends continuously on $γ$. The trivial example is given by $g$ with constant curvature $K$ and $λ\equiv {\rm const.}$ such that $λ^2+K>0$. This article exhibits non-trivial Zoll magnetic systems for every genus-for genus $\ge 2$ these are the first such examples.
